purpose: Teach: 如何なる/原著/生い立ち/懇願/物言い/卵子/破局/公道

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、如何なる困難も学術で克服した事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — I see you wrote your paper on how difficult subjects can be overcome through academic study.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle affirmation without ceremony. Slight upward lilt at the end — inviting confirmation, not lecturing. Steady presence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、海外哲学書の原著翻訳の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused my research on translating original foreign philosophy texts.
lines.style: Straightforward, earnest delivery. Direct eye contact in the voice. No flourish. The honesty of someone who means exactly what he says, nothing more.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、文豪の生い立ちの伝記研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — so you explored biographical research into a literary figure's life and upbringing, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly testing. Pause before the question — she's giving him room to correct her, not catching him out. Gentle curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、災害支援を懇願する自治体の声明を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — actually my paper examined municipal statements requesting disaster relief.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not defensive. The slight surprise of his own answer in his voice. Still earnest, but with the awareness that his work doesn't fit the boxes people expect.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、伝統的相撲の物言いの研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — and traditional sumo objection terminology was your focus, I believe?
lines.style: Measured, patient tone with subtle warmth. She's testing a pattern now, almost playfully. Not unkind — the way a good teacher checks if a student is really listening to himself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、不妊治療と卵子凍結の倫理研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually wrote on the ethics of fertility treatment and egg freezing.
lines.style: Steady, clear response. A flicker of recognition — he understands what she's doing. Still earnest, but with faint amusement at the mismatch. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、終戦時の社会の破局的状況の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — you examined the catastrophic social situation at the end of the war for your research?
lines.style: Knowing, gentle smile in the voice. She's been setting this up deliberately. Final confirmation before she makes her point. Warm and patient, not condescending.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、公道での自動運転実験の倫理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote on the ethics of autonomous vehicle testing on public roads.
lines.style: The quiet click of understanding. He gets what she's been doing — each deflection, each mismatch was deliberate. Slight closure in the tone. Earnest still, but with the faintest edge of self-awareness and gentle humor.
